title: Upside Down Text Generator
description: Flip your text upside down with real Unicode mappings — ˙ʇxǝʇ ǝdʎʇ noʎ — for fun bios and comments.
howto: It flips instantly using Unicode upside-down character mappings (and reverses the order).
Copy and paste it anywhere for a playful effect.

faqs.a: Each character is replaced by a Unicode lookalike that resembles it rotated 180° (e.g. "a" → "ɐ"), then the whole string is reversed so it reads correctly when flipped.
Letters, digits and common punctuation have mappings. Characters without a good upside-down twin are kept as-is.
Poorly — screen readers speak the Unicode names of the flipped characters. Use it for decoration, not for important information.
